description: Client-side script for the 'Chart of Accounts Importer' form in ERPNext, handling form events, UI interactions, and data validation for importing chart of accounts.

classes.name: frappe.ui.Tree
classes.description: UI component for displaying hierarchical tree structures, used here to preview chart of accounts.

methods.name: download_template
methods.description: Opens a dialog to select and download a chart of accounts template in Excel or CSV format.

methods.name: import_file
methods.description: Handles the event when an import file is selected or removed, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: company
methods.description: Validates the selected company to ensure no existing transactions before allowing import.
